---
title: 'Procédure de test pour un processus de Wiener homogène : Test  de Olivier Gaudoin'
author: "TITO A. Rytrace"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: word_document
---


```{r}
test_wiener_homogene <- function(data,
                                 test_normalite = "shapiro",
                                 alpha = 0.05) {

  if (!all(c("t", "x") %in% names(data))) {
    stop("data doit contenir les colonnes 't' et 'x'")
  }

  t <- data$t
  x <- data$x

  if (length(t) != length(x)) {
    stop("t et x doivent avoir la même longueur")
  }

  if (any(diff(t) <= 0)) {
    stop("Les temps doivent être strictement croissants")
  }

  n <- length(t) - 1
  dt <- diff(t)
  dx <- diff(x)

  K <- floor(n / 2)
  if (K < 2) {
    stop("Il faut au moins 4 observations (K >= 2)")
  }

  Vk <- numeric(K)
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    i1 <- 2 * k - 1
    i2 <- 2 * k
    Vk[k] <- (dx[i2] / dt[i2] - dx[i1] / dt[i1]) /
              sqrt(1 / dt[i2] + 1 / dt[i1])
  }

  # Test de normalité
  p_norm <- switch(test_normalite,
    shapiro = shapiro.test(Vk)$p.value,
    anderson = {
      if (!requireNamespace("nortest", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Le package 'nortest' est requis.")
      nortest::ad.test(Vk)$p.value
    },
    cvm = {
      if (!requireNamespace("nortest", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Le package 'nortest' est requis.")
      nortest::cvm.test(Vk)$p.value
    },
    lilliefors = {
      if (!requireNamespace("nortest", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Le package 'nortest' est requis.")
      nortest::lillie.test(Vk)$p.value
    },
    jarque = {
      if (!requireNamespace("tseries", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Le package 'tseries' est requis.")
      tseries::jarque.bera.test(Vk)$p.value
    },
    agostino = {
      if (!requireNamespace("fBasics", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Le package 'fBasics' est requis.")
      # dagotest retourne trois p-values : on prend l'omnibus (3ème)
      fBasics::dagoTest(Vk)@test$p.value[3]
    },
    stop("test_normalite doit être 'shapiro', 'anderson', 'cvm', 'lilliefors', 'jarque' ou 'agostino'")
  )

  alpha_N <- alpha / 2
  if (p_norm < alpha_N) {
    return(list(
      rejet_H0 = TRUE,
      test = "N",
      p_value_norm = p_norm,
      p_value_mu = NA
    ))
  }

  # Test de moyenne nulle
  p_mu <- t.test(Vk, mu = 0)$p.value
  alpha_M <- alpha / 2
  rejet_M <- p_mu < alpha_M

  return(list(
    rejet_H0 = rejet_M,
    test = ifelse(rejet_M, "M", "Aucun"),
    p_value_norm = p_norm,
    p_value_mu = p_mu
  ))
}
```

# Application 

```{r}
# Application 

set.seed(47)

n <- 50
T_max <- 50
t_obs <- sort(runif(n, 0, T_max))
t <- c(0, t_obs)
mu <- 3
sigma <- 0.5


# HWP
z <- rnorm(n)
dt <- diff(t)                          
dX <- mu * dt + sigma * sqrt(dt) * z  
X <- c(0, cumsum(dX))                  

X_hom <- data.frame(t = t, x = X)
head(X_hom)


# NHWP

dX <- mu * diff(t^2) + sigma * sqrt(dt) * z

X <- c(0, cumsum(dX))

X_nhom <- data.frame(t = t, x = X)
head(X_nhom)
```

```{r}
# Wiener homogène
res_hom <- test_wiener_homogene(
  X_hom,
  test_normalite = "shapiro",
  alpha = 0.05
)

res_hom
```

```{r}

set.seed(123)

n <- 100
T_max <- 100

t_gamma <- sort(runif(n, 0, T_max))

dt_gamma <- diff(c(0, t_gamma))

shape <- 0.5
rate <- 0.5

dx_gamma <- rgamma(
  n,
  shape = shape * dt_gamma,
  rate = rate
)

x_gamma <- c(0, cumsum(dx_gamma))

data_gamma <- data.frame(
  t = c(0, t_gamma),
  x = x_gamma
)

r5 <- test_wiener_homogene(
  data = data_gamma,
  test_normalite = "shapiro",
  alpha = 0.05
)

print(r5)
```


```{r}
# Non homogène
res_nhom <- test_wiener_homogene(
  X_nhom,
  test_normalite = "shapiro",
  alpha = 0.05
)

res_nhom
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(47)

# Paramètres communs
T <- 50
delta <- 0.1
t_grid <- seq(0, T, by = delta)
n <- length(t_grid) - 1
dt <- diff(t_grid)
mu <- 0.05
sigma <- 1
z <- rnorm(n)

# Wiener homogène

dX_hom <- 1 * dt + sigma * sqrt(dt) * z
X_hom <- c(0, cumsum(dX_hom))


tobs_hom <- c(0, T * rbeta(20, shape1 = 5, shape2 = 2), T - 1)
tobs_hom <- sort(tobs_hom)
X_obs_hom <- approx(t_grid, X_hom, xout = tobs_hom, rule = 2)$y

df_traj_hom <- data.frame(t = t_grid, X = X_hom)
df_obs_hom <- data.frame(t = tobs_hom, X = X_obs_hom)

p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = df_traj_hom, aes(x = t, y = X), color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = df_obs_hom, aes(x = t, y = X), color = "blue", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Temps", y = "X(t)", title = "HWP") +
  theme_minimal()


dX_nhom <- mu * diff(t_grid^2) + 7 * sqrt(dt) * z
X_nhom <- c(0, cumsum(dX_nhom))



tobs_nhom <- c(0, T * runif(20, 0, 1), T - 1)
tobs_nhom <- sort(tobs_nhom)
X_obs_nhom <- approx(t_grid, X_nhom, xout = tobs_nhom, rule = 2)$y

df_traj_nhom <- data.frame(t = t_grid, X = X_nhom)
df_obs_nhom <- data.frame(t = tobs_nhom, X = X_obs_nhom)

p2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = df_traj_nhom, aes(x = t, y = X), color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = df_obs_nhom, aes(x = t, y = X), color = "blue", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Temps", y = "X(t)", title = "NHWP") +
  theme_minimal()


p1 + p2
```

# Niveau et puissance des tets 

```{r}
# HWP
sim_hwp <- function(t_obs, mu, sigma) {
  dt <- diff(t_obs)
  dx <- mu * dt + sigma * sqrt(dt) * rnorm(length(dt))
  x <- c(0, cumsum(dx))
  return(cbind(t = t_obs, x = x))
}

# NHWP
sim_nhwp <- function(t_obs, sigma_true) {
  mu <- 1
  dt <- diff(t_obs)

  dX <- mu * diff(t_obs^2) +
        sigma_true * sqrt(dt) * rnorm(length(dt))

  x <- c(0, cumsum(dX))

  return(cbind(t = t_obs, x = x))
}
```

```{r}
MC_wiener <- function(
    N = 1000,
    scenario,
    t_obs,
    mu = NULL,
    sigma = NULL,
    sigma_true = NULL,
    alpha = 0.05
){

  tests <- c(
    "shapiro",
    "jarque",
    "lilliefors",
    "anderson",
    "cvm",
    "agostino"
  )

  une_iter <- function(i){

    # Génération de la trajectoire
    if (!is.null(mu) && !is.null(sigma)) {

      X <- scenario(
        t_obs = t_obs,
        mu = mu,
        sigma = sigma
      )

    } else if (!is.null(sigma_true)) {

      X <- scenario(
        t_obs = t_obs,
        sigma_true = sigma_true
      )

    } else {

      stop(
        "Spécifiez soit (mu, sigma), soit sigma_true."
      )
    }

    X <- as.data.frame(X)
    names(X) <- c("t", "x")

    # Application des différents tests
    res <- vapply(
      tests,
      function(test_norm){

        as.integer(
          test_wiener_homogene(
            data = X,
            test_normalite = test_norm,
            alpha = alpha
          )$rejet_H0
        )

      },
      integer(1)
    )

    return(res)
  }

  res_mat <- replicate(
    N,
    une_iter(1)
  )

  taux_rejet <- rowMeans(res_mat)

  names(taux_rejet) <- c(
    "Shapiro",
    "JarqueBera",
    "Lilliefors",
    "Anderson",
    "CramerVonMises",
    "DAgostino"
  )

  return(taux_rejet)
}
```

# Niveau 

```{r}
set.seed(46)

n <- 100
Tmax <- 50

t_obs <- c(0, sort(runif(n, 0, Tmax)))
```


```{r}
MC_wiener(
  N = 5000,
  scenario = sim_hwp,
  t_obs = t_obs,
  mu = 1,
  sigma = 0.5
)
```

```{r}
n =55
t_obs <- c(0, sort(runif(n, 0, Tmax)))
puissance <- MC_wiener(
  N = 1000,
  scenario = sim_nhwp,
  t_obs = t_obs,
  sigma_true = 1,
  alpha = 0.5
)

puissance
```
